reviewer: Claude Opus 5 (High) — automated review commissioned and directed by the project maintainer
review_type: Maintainer-directed automated source and security review; not an independent human assessment
remediation_validation: Claude Opus 5 (High) performed three maintainer-directed automated review passes culminating in commit 32c72c0. Local Docker and PostgreSQL gates corroborate the remediation. A human third-party assessment remains required before 1.0.

findings.title: Entity search disclosed inaccessible organizations and client contacts
findings.disposition: Entity discovery now intersects supported record classes, governing view permissions, accessible organizations, person associations, and actor-bound RLS anchor policies.

findings.title: Organizations were open to all authorized staff by default
findings.disposition: New organizations now default to assigned-only access; the creation UI states the fail-closed behavior and owners retain break-glass access.

findings.title: Blank entity search bypassed record-class permissions
findings.disposition: All discovery paths are constrained server-side to the explicit searchable catalog and each type's governing read permission; mention filters use the same bounded choices.

findings.title: Authorization requests were not exercised through the runtime database role
findings.disposition: A shared fixture reconnects Django as the non-superuser runtime role. Dedicated regressions cover entity anchors and worker boundaries, while an exhaustive constrained-role pass exercises every cataloged authenticated route against anonymous, non-member, read-only, CSRF, and MFA-denial cases.

findings.title: Publication verification lacks an operator trust anchor
findings.disposition: Verification now trusts only the current deployment key and explicitly configured retired-key fingerprints; a valid self-signed publication from an unknown key is rejected.

findings.title: Outbound webhook HTTP occurs inside a database transaction
findings.disposition: Delivery claiming and outcome persistence now use separate short transactions; outbound network I/O occurs after the claim transaction commits and stale workers cannot overwrite a newer lease.

findings.title: Inbound webhook endpoint lacks anonymous throttling
findings.disposition: Inbound webhook requests are bounded by an endpoint-and-IP throttle and unknown endpoints return the same authentication failure shape as invalid signatures.

findings.title: Attachment quarantine is structural validation rather than antivirus
findings.disposition: Production requires a fail-closed ClamAV streaming provider in addition to structural validation; local structural-only behavior and the external scanner trust boundary are documented explicitly.

findings.title: Base Compose defaults can appear production-ready while remaining development-shaped
findings.disposition: Insecure URL and SMTP behavior now require explicit development opt-ins, production settings reject development images, and the production rehearsal asserts the image variant, scanner provider, secret boundaries, and container hardening.

findings.title: OIDC verified-email auto-connect needs an explicit MFA regression
findings.disposition: An explicit social-login pipeline regression proves an existing account with enrolled TOTP remains in the MFA authentication stage and receives no authenticated session; issuer constraints are documented.

findings.title: Backup encryption uses one AES-GCM nonce per artifact stream
findings.disposition: Encryption and decryption now enforce a 16 GiB plaintext artifact ceiling, with the supported limit and recovery-key compromise boundary documented for operators.

findings.title: Nested RLS bindings cleared the request actor and blinded organization anchors
findings.disposition: Nested user scopes preserve the request principal. Background work uses an explicit tenant/workspace-scoped system principal whose prior actor and principal are restored on exit. Organization-anchor RLS recognizes only those two principal modes.

findings.title: Attachment bytes could stream to an unvalidated ClamAV host
findings.disposition: TekDocs rejects scanner names unless every resolved address is private, loopback, or link-local, pins the selected address for the connection, ships a digest-pinned private ClamAV service, and exercises a live scan in the production-image rehearsal.

findings.title: Domain inventory was sent to Cloudflare DNS by default
findings.disposition: DNS-over-HTTPS monitoring is disabled by default and requires an explicit operator-selected endpoint; the disclosure and privacy boundary are documented.

findings.title: Application and RLS person visibility rules disagreed in the MSP workspace
findings.disposition: MSP entity discovery now exposes only MSP-associated people and matches the database policy, including archived-association filtering.

findings.title: Local test targets executed stale baked source
findings.disposition: Every backend-bearing local test and check gate now rebuilds the backend and migration test images before execution, so the source under test matches the working tree without changing persistent development data.

findings.title: Person-anchor RLS trusted organization binding without a principal
findings.disposition: Person-anchor visibility now requires an explicit USER or SYSTEM principal. User organization scope delegates entitlement to the organization-anchor policy, MSP scope requires MSP staff membership, and unbound transactions fail closed.

findings.title: All-authorized organization RLS accepted users without MSP membership
findings.disposition: The all-authorized branch now requires a tenant membership with no client organization, matching the intended all-authorized-MSP-staff meaning while preserving owner, explicit assignment, portal, and SYSTEM paths.

findings.title: Public inbound webhook processing entered the SYSTEM principal
findings.disposition: After signature and payload verification, inbound receipt creation binds only the endpoint tenant scope. It no longer enters SYSTEM mode or dereferences RLS-protected organization relations.

findings.title: Legacy RLS helper functions retain PostgreSQL PUBLIC EXECUTE
findings.disposition: Migration 0109 revokes PUBLIC EXECUTE from all four legacy scope helpers and grants EXECUTE only to the runtime role. A PostgreSQL migration-cycle regression proves the forward and reverse ACL states and executes each helper as an unrelated login role to verify denial after reapplication.

findings.title: Additional isolation modules still rely primarily on owner-role execution
findings.disposition: Focused constrained-role regressions now cover assigned-client workspace entry and discovery, exact-organization client portal initialization, and scoped-manager composition with forced RLS. The portal regression also corrected request initialization so organization-bound users enter their exact database scope before protected relations are resolved. Existing granular owner-role regressions remain in place.
